reason: I already paid for salon software once and my staff never touched it, so I cancelled. Making every stylist take a selfie and type a mobile number for each walk-in sounds like more work they will skip, and many of my customers won't give their number anyway.
objection: My staff won't use it day to day, and half my customers won't share their mobile number, so the reminders, wallet and referral part won't work. I'd be paying ₹999 every month for a register nobody fills in.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and pay only after it has actually been used by my staff for two to three months, ideally with the app in Hindi as well and billing without needing a mobile number.
